attributes.description: Fleet Data Stream configuration guide, collection stream health, and per-deployment ECH & Serverless harvest registry.
End-to-end health of Chargeback's three Fleet CEL data streams (Billing, Usage, and Node Stats) across discovered ECH deployments and Serverless projects.

query.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost, chargeback_lookup.cluster_deployment_contribution METADATA _index
| EVAL is_bill_row = (_index LIKE "*billing_cluster_cost*"), is_usage_row = (_index LIKE "*cluster_deployment_contribution*")
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL AND deployment_id IS NOT NULL AND (is_bill_row OR is_usage_row)
| EVAL ts = @timestamp, ck = composite_key::keyword, b_dep_id = deployment_id, own_store_size = deployment_sum_store_size
| INLINE STATS _ck_bill_rows = COUNT(CASE(is_bill_row, 1, null)) BY ck
| WHERE is_bill_row OR COALESCE(_ck_bill_rows, 0) == 0
| DROP _ck_bill_rows, composite_key, deployment_id, @timestamp, deployment_name, deployment_group, deployment_sum_store_size, deployment_sum_indexing_time, deployment_sum_query_time, deployment_sum_data_set_store_size, cluster_name, usage_source
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.cluster_deployment_contribution ON ck == composite_key
| EVAL eff_store_size = COALESCE(own_store_size, deployment_sum_store_size)
| EVAL has_usage = CASE(eff_store_size IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)
| DROP composite_key, deployment_id, @timestamp
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| EVAL has_util = CASE(heap_used_pct_p95 IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)
| DROP composite_key, deployment_id, @timestamp
| EVAL is_onprem_flag = CASE(COALESCE(is_onprem, ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("onprem", "ece", "eck") OR cloud.provider == "onprem", false), 1, 0), cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, cloud_sym = conf_currency_symbol
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, conf_currency_symbol
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL rate = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)), unit = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR")), sym = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_currency_symbol)) > 0, TRIM(conf_currency_symbol), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0, TRIM(cloud_sym), null), "€"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0, TRIM(cloud_sym), null), "€"))
| EVAL cloud_r = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 0, rate, null), onprem_r = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, rate, null)
| EVAL is_ech = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 0 AND (ess.billing.deployment_type == "deployment" OR cloud.provider IN ("aws", "gcp", "azure", "cloud") OR (NOT is_bill_row AND has_util == 1)), 1, 0)
| EVAL is_node_target = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1 OR is_ech == 1, 1, 0)
| EVAL is_fresh = CASE(DATE_DIFF("hour", ts, NOW()) <= 72, 1, 0)
| EVAL bill_ts = CASE(is_bill_row, ts, null), bill_units = CASE(is_bill_row, COALESCE(total_chargeable_units, 0.0), 0.0)
| EVAL ech_id = CASE(is_ech == 1, b_dep_id, null), sls_id = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 0 AND is_ech == 0, b_dep_id, null), onprem_id = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, b_dep_id, null), node_target_id = CASE(is_node_target == 1, b_dep_id, null)
| EVAL billed_dep_id = CASE(is_bill_row, b_dep_id, null), fresh_bill_id = CASE(is_bill_row AND is_fresh == 1, b_dep_id, null), usage_dep_id = CASE(has_usage == 1, b_dep_id, null), fresh_usage_id = CASE(is_fresh == 1 AND has_usage == 1, b_dep_id, null), util_dep_id = CASE(is_node_target == 1 AND has_util == 1, b_dep_id, null), fresh_util_id = CASE(is_fresh == 1 AND is_node_target == 1 AND has_util == 1, b_dep_id, null)
| STATS
    total_deps = COUNT_DISTINCT(b_dep_id),
    billed_deps = COUNT_DISTINCT(billed_dep_id),
    fresh_bill_deps = COUNT_DISTINCT(fresh_bill_id),
    ech_deps = COUNT_DISTINCT(ech_id),
    sls_deps = COUNT_DISTINCT(sls_id),
    onprem_deps = COUNT_DISTINCT(onprem_id),
    node_target_deps = COUNT_DISTINCT(node_target_id),
    usage_deps = COUNT_DISTINCT(usage_dep_id),
    fresh_usage_deps = COUNT_DISTINCT(fresh_usage_id),
    util_deps = COUNT_DISTINCT(util_dep_id),
    fresh_util_deps = COUNT_DISTINCT(fresh_util_id),
    total_ecu = ROUND(SUM(CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, bill_units / 1000.0, bill_units)), 2),
    total_cost = ROUND(SUM(bill_units * rate), 2),
    unit_vals = VALUES(unit),
    sym_vals = VALUES(sym),
    active_cloud_rate = MAX(cloud_r),
    active_onprem_rate = MAX(onprem_r),
    latest_ts = MAX(bill_ts)
| EVAL
    active_unit = MV_MAX(unit_vals),
    active_sym = MV_MAX(sym_vals),
    `Billing Stream` = CASE(billed_deps == 0, "Awaiting poll", fresh_bill_deps > 0, CONCAT("Active (", TO_STRING(fresh_bill_deps), " / ", TO_STRING(total_deps), " fresh)"), CONCAT("Stale (last ", LEFT(TO_STRING(latest_ts), 10), ")")),
    `Platform Mix` = CASE(onprem_deps > 0, CONCAT(TO_STRING(ech_deps), " ECH · ", TO_STRING(sls_deps), " Serverless · ", TO_STRING(onprem_deps), " On-Prem"), CONCAT(TO_STRING(ech_deps), " ECH · ", TO_STRING(sls_deps), " Serverless")),
    `Usage Stream (/_stats)` = CASE(total_deps == 0, "Awaiting poll", fresh_usage_deps > 0, CONCAT("Active (", TO_STRING(fresh_usage_deps), " / ", TO_STRING(total_deps), " fresh)"), usage_deps > 0, CONCAT("Stale (", TO_STRING(usage_deps), " historical)"), "Missing"),
    `Node Stats Stream (ECH)` = CASE(node_target_deps == 0, "N/A (Serverless only)", fresh_util_deps > 0, CONCAT("Active (", TO_STRING(fresh_util_deps), " / ", TO_STRING(node_target_deps), " fresh)"), util_deps > 0, CONCAT("Stale (", TO_STRING(util_deps), " historical)"), "100% fallback (Missing)"),
    `Historical Coverage` = CONCAT(TO_STRING(billed_deps), " billed · ", TO_STRING(usage_deps), " usage · ", TO_STRING(util_deps), " node stats"),
    `Billing Currency & Rate` = CASE(onprem_deps > 0 AND (ech_deps + sls_deps) > 0, CONCAT(COALESCE(active_unit, "EUR"), " ", COALESCE(active_sym, "€"), " (×", TO_STRING(ROUND(COALESCE(active_cloud_rate, 0.85), 4)), "/ECU · ×", TO_STRING(ROUND(COALESCE(active_onprem_rate, 0.00085) * 1000.0, 4)), "/ERU)"), onprem_deps > 0, CONCAT(COALESCE(active_unit, "EUR"), " ", COALESCE(active_sym, "€"), " (×", TO_STRING(ROUND(COALESCE(active_onprem_rate, 0.00085) * 1000.0, 4)), "/ERU)"), CONCAT(COALESCE(active_unit, "EUR"), " ", COALESCE(active_sym, "€"), " (×", TO_STRING(ROUND(COALESCE(active_cloud_rate, 0.85), 4)), "/ECU)")),
    `Billed ECU` = total_ecu,
    `Normalized Spend` = total_cost,
    `Latest Billing Day` = COALESCE(LEFT(TO_STRING(latest_ts), 10), "—")
| KEEP `Billing Stream`, `Platform Mix`, `Usage Stream (/_stats)`, `Node Stats Stream (ECH)`, `Historical Coverage`, `Billing Currency & Rate`, `Billed ECU`, `Normalized Spend`, `Latest Billing Day`
| LIMIT 10

embeddableConfig.title: Fleet Data Stream & Collection Coverage Summary

attributes.description: Discovered ECH deployments, Serverless projects, and On-Premises clusters with live status for billing, hourly index/tier usage (/_stats and /_settings), and 15m data-node JVM/disk utilization.

query.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost, chargeback_lookup.cluster_deployment_contribution METADATA _index
| EVAL is_bill_row = (_index LIKE "*billing_cluster_cost*"), is_usage_row = (_index LIKE "*cluster_deployment_contribution*")
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL AND deployment_id IS NOT NULL AND (is_bill_row OR is_usage_row)
| EVAL ts = @timestamp, ck = composite_key::keyword, b_dep_id = deployment_id, own_dep_name = deployment_name, own_dep_grp = deployment_group, own_store_size = deployment_sum_store_size
| INLINE STATS _ck_bill_rows = COUNT(CASE(is_bill_row, 1, null)) BY ck
| WHERE is_bill_row OR COALESCE(_ck_bill_rows, 0) == 0
| DROP _ck_bill_rows, composite_key, deployment_id, @timestamp, deployment_name, deployment_group, deployment_sum_store_size, deployment_sum_indexing_time, deployment_sum_query_time, deployment_sum_data_set_store_size, cluster_name, usage_source
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.cluster_deployment_contribution ON ck == composite_key
| EVAL eff_store_size = COALESCE(own_store_size, deployment_sum_store_size), eff_dep_name = CASE(own_dep_name IS NOT NULL AND own_dep_name != "", own_dep_name, deployment_name), eff_dep_grp = CASE(own_dep_grp IS NOT NULL AND own_dep_grp != "", own_dep_grp, deployment_group)
| EVAL store_gib = TO_DOUBLE(eff_store_size) / 1073741824.0
| EVAL u_day = CASE(eff_store_size IS NOT NULL, ts, null)
| DROP composite_key, deployment_id, @timestamp
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| EVAL n_day = CASE(heap_used_pct_p95 IS NOT NULL, ts, null)
| DROP composite_key, deployment_id, @timestamp
| EVAL is_onprem_flag = CASE(COALESCE(is_onprem, ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("onprem", "ece", "eck") OR cloud.provider == "onprem", false), 1, 0), cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, cloud_sym = conf_currency_symbol
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, conf_currency_symbol
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL rate = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)),
       unit = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR")),
       sym = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_currency_symbol)) > 0, TRIM(conf_currency_symbol), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0, TRIM(cloud_sym), null), "€"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0, TRIM(cloud_sym), null), "€"))
| EVAL is_ech = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 0 AND (ess.billing.deployment_type == "deployment" OR cloud.provider IN ("aws", "gcp", "azure", "cloud") OR (NOT is_bill_row AND n_day IS NOT NULL)), 1, 0)
| EVAL grp = CASE(eff_dep_grp IS NOT NULL AND eff_dep_grp != "", eff_dep_grp, "(unassigned)")
| EVAL reg = CASE(cloud.region IS NOT NULL AND cloud.region != "" AND cloud.region != "unknown", cloud.region, null)
| EVAL bill_ts = CASE(is_bill_row, ts, null), bill_units = CASE(is_bill_row, COALESCE(total_chargeable_units, 0.0), 0.0)
| STATS
    dep_names = VALUES(eff_dep_name),
    has_onprem = MAX(is_onprem_flag),
    has_ech = MAX(is_ech),
    reg_vals = VALUES(reg),
    grp_vals = VALUES(grp),
    unit_vals = VALUES(unit),
    sym_vals = VALUES(sym),
    billed_days = COUNT_DISTINCT(bill_ts),
    last_bill_ts = MAX(bill_ts),
    usage_days = COUNT_DISTINCT(u_day),
    last_usage_ts = MAX(u_day),
    max_store_gib = MAX(store_gib),
    util_days = COUNT_DISTINCT(n_day),
    last_util_ts = MAX(n_day),
    avg_heap = AVG(heap_used_pct_p95),
    avg_disk = AVG(disk_used_pct_p95),
    `Billed ECU` = ROUND(SUM(CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, bill_units / 1000.0, bill_units)), 2),
    `Normalized Cost` = ROUND(SUM(bill_units * rate), 2)
  BY b_dep_id
| EVAL
    dep_name = MV_MAX(dep_names),
    `Currency` = CONCAT(COALESCE(MV_MAX(sym_vals), "€"), " ", COALESCE(MV_MAX(unit_vals), "EUR")),
    `Region` = COALESCE(MV_MAX(reg_vals), "—"),
    `Chargeback Group` = COALESCE(MV_MAX(grp_vals), "(unassigned)"),
    `Platform` = CASE(has_onprem == 1, "On-Premises", has_ech == 1, "ECH", "Serverless"),
    bill_age_h = DATE_DIFF("hour", last_bill_ts, NOW()),
    usage_age_h = DATE_DIFF("hour", last_usage_ts, NOW()),
    util_age_h = DATE_DIFF("hour", last_util_ts, NOW()),
    `Deployment` = CONCAT(COALESCE(dep_name, b_dep_id), " (", LEFT(b_dep_id, 6), ")"),
    `Billing Stream` = CASE(last_bill_ts IS NULL, "Missing", bill_age_h <= 72, "Active", CONCAT("Stale (last ", LEFT(TO_STRING(last_bill_ts), 10), ")")),
    `Usage Stream (/_stats)` = CASE(last_usage_ts IS NULL, "Missing (Needs ES API key)", usage_age_h <= 72, CONCAT("Active · ", TO_STRING(ROUND(COALESCE(max_store_gib, 0.0), 2)), " GiB"), CONCAT("Stale (last ", LEFT(TO_STRING(last_usage_ts), 10), ")")),
    `Node Stats Stream (JVM/Disk)` = CASE(`Platform` == "Serverless", "N/A (Serverless)", last_util_ts IS NULL, "100% fallback (Missing)", util_age_h <= 72, CONCAT("Active · Heap ", TO_STRING(ROUND(COALESCE(avg_heap, 0.0), 1)), "% / Disk ", TO_STRING(ROUND(COALESCE(avg_disk, 0.0), 1)), "%"), CONCAT("Stale (last ", LEFT(TO_STRING(last_util_ts), 10), ")")),
    `Coverage Days (Bill / Usage / Util)` = CONCAT(TO_STRING(billed_days), "d / ", TO_STRING(usage_days), "d / ", CASE(`Platform` == "Serverless", "—", CONCAT(TO_STRING(util_days), "d"))),
    `Latest Billing Day` = COALESCE(LEFT(TO_STRING(last_bill_ts), 10), "—")
| SORT `Normalized Cost` DESC, `Deployment` ASC
| KEEP `Deployment`, `Platform`, `Region`, `Chargeback Group`, `Billing Stream`, `Usage Stream (/_stats)`, `Node Stats Stream (JVM/Disk)`, `Coverage Days (Bill / Usage / Util)`, `Currency`, `Billed ECU`, `Normalized Cost`, `Latest Billing Day`
| LIMIT 200

FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost, chargeback_lookup.cluster_deployment_contribution METADATA _index
| EVAL is_bill_row = (_index LIKE "*billing_cluster_cost*"), is_usage_row = (_index LIKE "*cluster_deployment_contribution*")
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL AND deployment_id IS NOT NULL AND (is_bill_row OR is_usage_row)
| EVAL ts = @timestamp, ck = composite_key::keyword, b_dep_id = deployment_id, own_dep_name = deployment_name, own_dep_grp = deployment_group, own_store_size = deployment_sum_store_size
| INLINE STATS _ck_bill_rows = COUNT(CASE(is_bill_row, 1, null)) BY ck
| WHERE is_bill_row OR COALESCE(_ck_bill_rows, 0) == 0
| DROP _ck_bill_rows, composite_key, deployment_id, @timestamp, deployment_name, deployment_group, deployment_sum_store_size, deployment_sum_indexing_time, deployment_sum_query_time, deployment_sum_data_set_store_size, cluster_name, usage_source
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.cluster_deployment_contribution ON ck == composite_key
| EVAL eff_store_size = COALESCE(own_store_size, deployment_sum_store_size), eff_dep_name = CASE(own_dep_name IS NOT NULL AND own_dep_name != "", own_dep_name, deployment_name), eff_dep_grp = CASE(own_dep_grp IS NOT NULL AND own_dep_grp != "", own_dep_grp, deployment_group)
| EVAL store_gib = TO_DOUBLE(eff_store_size) / 1073741824.0
| EVAL u_day = CASE(eff_store_size IS NOT NULL, ts, null)
| DROP composite_key, deployment_id, @timestamp
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| EVAL n_day = CASE(heap_used_pct_p95 IS NOT NULL, ts, null)
| DROP composite_key, deployment_id, @timestamp
| EVAL is_onprem_flag = CASE(COALESCE(is_onprem, ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("onprem", "ece", "eck") OR cloud.provider == "onprem", false), 1, 0), cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, cloud_sym = conf_currency_symbol
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, conf_currency_symbol
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL rate = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)),
       unit = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR")),
       sym = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_currency_symbol)) > 0, TRIM(conf_currency_symbol), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0, TRIM(cloud_sym), null), "€"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0, TRIM(cloud_sym), null), "€"))
| EVAL is_ech = CASE(is_onprem_flag == 0 AND (ess.billing.deployment_type == "deployment" OR cloud.provider IN ("aws", "gcp", "azure", "cloud") OR (NOT is_bill_row AND n_day IS NOT NULL)), 1, 0)
| EVAL grp = CASE(eff_dep_grp IS NOT NULL AND eff_dep_grp != "", eff_dep_grp, "(unassigned)")
| EVAL reg = CASE(cloud.region IS NOT NULL AND cloud.region != "" AND cloud.region != "unknown", cloud.region, null)
| EVAL bill_ts = CASE(is_bill_row, ts, null), bill_units = CASE(is_bill_row, COALESCE(total_chargeable_units, 0.0), 0.0)
| STATS
    dep_names = VALUES(eff_dep_name),
    has_onprem = MAX(is_onprem_flag),
    has_ech = MAX(is_ech),
    reg_vals = VALUES(reg),
    grp_vals = VALUES(grp),
    unit_vals = VALUES(unit),
    sym_vals = VALUES(sym),
    billed_days = COUNT_DISTINCT(bill_ts),
    last_bill_ts = MAX(bill_ts),
    usage_days = COUNT_DISTINCT(u_day),
    last_usage_ts = MAX(u_day),
    max_store_gib = MAX(store_gib),
    util_days = COUNT_DISTINCT(n_day),
    last_util_ts = MAX(n_day),
    avg_heap = AVG(heap_used_pct_p95),
    avg_disk = AVG(disk_used_pct_p95),
    `Billed ECU` = ROUND(SUM(CASE(is_onprem_flag == 1, bill_units / 1000.0, bill_units)), 2),
    `Normalized Cost` = ROUND(SUM(bill_units * rate), 2)
  BY b_dep_id
| EVAL
    dep_name = MV_MAX(dep_names),
    `Currency` = CONCAT(COALESCE(MV_MAX(sym_vals), "€"), " ", COALESCE(MV_MAX(unit_vals), "EUR")),
    `Region` = COALESCE(MV_MAX(reg_vals), "—"),
    `Chargeback Group` = COALESCE(MV_MAX(grp_vals), "(unassigned)"),
    `Platform` = CASE(has_onprem == 1, "On-Premises", has_ech == 1, "ECH", "Serverless"),
    bill_age_h = DATE_DIFF("hour", last_bill_ts, NOW()),
    usage_age_h = DATE_DIFF("hour", last_usage_ts, NOW()),
    util_age_h = DATE_DIFF("hour", last_util_ts, NOW()),
    `Deployment` = CONCAT(COALESCE(dep_name, b_dep_id), " (", LEFT(b_dep_id, 6), ")"),
    `Billing Stream` = CASE(last_bill_ts IS NULL, "Missing", bill_age_h <= 72, "Active", CONCAT("Stale (last ", LEFT(TO_STRING(last_bill_ts), 10), ")")),
    `Usage Stream (/_stats)` = CASE(last_usage_ts IS NULL, "Missing (Needs ES API key)", usage_age_h <= 72, CONCAT("Active · ", TO_STRING(ROUND(COALESCE(max_store_gib, 0.0), 2)), " GiB"), CONCAT("Stale (last ", LEFT(TO_STRING(last_usage_ts), 10), ")")),
    `Node Stats Stream (JVM/Disk)` = CASE(`Platform` == "Serverless", "N/A (Serverless)", last_util_ts IS NULL, "100% fallback (Missing)", util_age_h <= 72, CONCAT("Active · Heap ", TO_STRING(ROUND(COALESCE(avg_heap, 0.0), 1)), "% / Disk ", TO_STRING(ROUND(COALESCE(avg_disk, 0.0), 1)), "%"), CONCAT("Stale (last ", LEFT(TO_STRING(last_util_ts), 10), ")")),
    `Coverage Days (Bill / Usage / Util)` = CONCAT(TO_STRING(billed_days), "d / ", TO_STRING(usage_days), "d / ", CASE(`Platform` == "Serverless", "—", CONCAT(TO_STRING(util_days), "d"))),
    `Latest Billing Day` = COALESCE(LEFT(TO_STRING(last_bill_ts), 10), "—")
| SORT `Normalized Cost` DESC, `Deployment` ASC
| KEEP `Deployment`, `Platform`, `Region`, `Chargeback Group`, `Billing Stream`, `Usage Stream (/_stats)`, `Node Stats Stream (JVM/Disk)`, `Coverage Days (Bill / Usage / Util)`, `Currency`, `Billed ECU`, `Normalized Cost`, `Latest Billing Day`
| LIMIT 200

embeddableConfig.description: Discovered ECH deployments, Serverless projects, and On-Premises clusters with live status for billing, 10-minute index/tier usage (/_stats and /_settings), and 15m data-node JVM/disk utilization.
embeddableConfig.title: Per-Deployment Harvest & Telemetry Registry

params.markdown:
### Step 1 — Elastic Cloud & Cluster Access
Configure shared credentials in **Kibana → Fleet → Agent Policies → Chargeback → Elastic Cloud & Cluster Access**:

- **`Organization ID` & `Elastic Cloud API Key`** (`organization_id`, `cloud_api_key`): Elastic Cloud API key with **Billing Admin** role and Cloud deployment / Serverless project read access. Leave empty for On-Premises / local Hub-only collection alongside **On-Premises Billing** (`metrics-ess_billing.billing-onprem*`) or a compatible billing producer.
- **`Target Deployment Elasticsearch API Keys`** (`deployment_api_keys`): Optional least-privileged ES API keys (`<deployment_id_or_name>:<encoded_key>`) for direct collection from remote ECH clusters or Serverless projects.
- **`Local / Hub Elasticsearch URL` & `Local / Hub Elasticsearch API Key`** (`hub_es_url`, `hub_es_api_key`): Optional direct endpoint and key for harvesting the local or self-managed Hub cluster. (Cross-Cluster Search remains supported via `*:monitoring-indices*`.)
- **Deployment grouping**: Tag deployments in Cloud Console with `chargeback_group:<team_name>` to group spend by tenant.

### Step 2 — Per-Data-Stream UI Settings
Currency rates, optional credit commitments, and cost/utilization weights are managed inside each data stream's UI config in **Fleet**:

- **Elastic Cloud Daily Billing & Rate Settings (`chargeback.billing`)**: `Billing Lookbehind Days`, `Currency Unit` (for example `EUR`, `USD`), `Currency Symbol` (for example `€`, `$`, `£`, `R`), `Chargeable Unit Rate` (Elastic Cloud ECU, default `0.85`), `On-Premises Unit Rate (per mERU)` (default `0.00085`), `Configuration Effective Start Date (Optional)` (`config_effective_from`, UTC day boundary `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z`), and `Collect ESS Credit Commitment Data (for stock ESS Billing Credits dashboard)`.
- **Index & Tier Usage (`chargeback.usage`)**: `Blended Indexing Weight`, `Blended Query Weight`, and `Blended Storage Weight`.
- **Elastic Cloud Data Node Utilization (15m) (`chargeback.node_stats`)**: `Utilization Memory (Heap p95) Weight`, `Utilization Storage (Disk p95) Weight`, and `Utilization Floor`.
- **Manual / multi-period preservation**: Disable `Sync Fleet Rate & Weight Settings to Configuration Lookup` (`sync_fleet_config`) when managing custom or historical rate periods manually in `chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf` (use `POST chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf/_update/config` for Cloud ECU rates and `POST chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf/_update/config_onprem` with `"config_join_key": "chargeback_config_onprem"` for On-Premises mERU rates).

### Step 3 — Automatic Transforms & Compatibility Aliases
Chargeback runs self-contained collection and continuous transforms automatically (`5m` configuration sync and `60m` billing, usage, and utilization rollups):

- **Lookup sync**: Saving changes in the Fleet Data Stream UI (and daily snapshot renewal) emits a lightweight `config_snapshot` event and updates `chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf` (`_id: config` for Elastic Cloud ECU and `_id: config_onprem` for On-Premises mERU) without re-emitting billing line items.
- **Freshness vs. coverage**: Stream status reflects telemetry received within the last 72 hours (`Active` vs. `Stale`), while historical coverage counts are reported separately.
- **Stock dashboard compatibility** *(opt-in)*: Chargeback writes to versioned aliases `chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost`, `chargeback_lookup.billing_realized_pool`, `chargeback_lookup.cluster_tier_and_datastream_contribution`, and `metrics-chargeback.usage-*` (`10m` per-index samples) without colliding with `ess_billing` or `index_pivot`. Standalone clusters can expose `metrics-ess_billing.billing-chargeback`, `metrics-ess_billing.credits-chargeback`, and `monitoring-indices` via `POST /_aliases` (see package documentation).
